text:
Galaxy S25 is the best value of the three: the fastest chip, a 120Hz screen and three rear cameras for about the same money. The prices are launch prices in India for the base AI, from memory, so please check today's street price before buying. If you live in Apple's world, the iPhone 16 still makes more sense.
